verdict.rationale: Firecrawl says it covers JS-heavy pages (gh-8) and returns content as HTML as well as markdown/JSON (docs-1). It also supports interacting with pages to extract dynamic content (docs-3) and offers managed browser sessions (docs-8). Community discussion confirms it runs a headless browser via Puppeteer (comm-3). Missing for 10: explicit docs that the HTML output is the post-JavaScript rendered DOM, documented rendering controls such as wait conditions, and independent hands-on confirmation of rendering client-side-only SPAs.
